significance.justification: A verified-true result would establish a form-(iii) predictive coupling—larger "commitment-lead" systematically predicts later belief-vs-fact errors better than final-token confidence—plus a form-(ii) causal claim that "attenuating the truth direction at pre-disambiguation positions" reduces those errors without degrading ordinary factual QA. This would establish both a temporal phenomenon and a mechanism, fixing expectations across late-decidable and garden-path propositions and changing the interpretation of latent truth readouts studied in Burns et al., "Discovering Latent Knowledge in Language Models Without Supervision" (ICLR 2023), and Marks and Tegmark, "The Geometry of Truth" (COLM 2024). True and false outcomes are distinguishable: failure to find a stable onset, predictive coupling, or selective intervention effect would rule out premature commitment as a general causal explanation, although it would not resolve other sources of belief/fact confusion. After topic substitution, generic research on internal item beliefs would not earn this score; the claim-specific temporal ordering and error-prediction law support an above-median rating.

reach.justification: The named handles are the "commitment-lead metric" and the intervention that suppresses the truth direction "until the proposition is fully read"; the former is an ex-ante warning signal available after reading the input but before answering, while the latter is a decode-time or model-level control. After re-extracting a truth direction on another model, the conclusion predicts a transferable relation—greater premature lead should forecast more errors—rather than merely supplying a procedure for rediscovering an unconstrained direction. Its asserted scope covers token-by-token proposition reading and multiple LLM families, and the likely downstream users include interpretability researchers, model auditors, and developers gating or modifying responses, but it does not claim transfer across modalities or outside AI. The topic-substitution check lowers no score here: research on LLM beliefs alone supplies neither this forward-looking timing metric nor its selective delaying intervention.
